title: 第21章 干得热火朝天第22章 不对劲的诺里斯
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 罗德结束了呼吸法后，盘腿坐在了垫子上。
开始进行冥想修炼。
在【沉浸】效果的辅助下，他能迅速进入冥想状态。
感受着魔素在体内流转，思维逐渐放空。
纷乱的思绪和各种负面情绪都像是垃圾一样被清扫了出去。
当他再次睁开眼时，整个脑海都无比的清爽。
体内的魔素质量有了些微提升。
【淬魔经验+2】
没有趁着体力恢复继续淬魔修行。
每天的精力总是有限的，欲速则不达。
罗德接下来跟菲利普一起练习飞刀和短弓射击。
刷了几点【投掷】和【远射】的经验。
他的技艺大致分为生活、战斗和杂艺。
生活技艺已激活的有十项。
分别是：
【建造】、【种植】、【采集】、【养殖】、【捕猎】、【烹饪】、【制造】、【匠技】、【医药】、【操控】。
几乎涵盖了所有广义中，种田和生产所必备的技艺。
全部掌握精通后，他就是领主全能王。
如果想尽可能的多刷经验。
他得抽出时间和精力去干活。
真正做到从群众中来，到群众中去。
罗德始终牢记高筑墙、广积粮、缓称王的九字箴言。
如果说种田是稳健发育的日常。
那么战斗才是领主的浪漫
他已激活的战斗技艺有六项：
【淬魔】、【投掷】、【远射】、【兵击】、【招架】、【跑动】。
其中【投掷】还能与【掷骰术】双向奔赴互相加成。
事实证明，他的这些技艺都能实现互补或是buff叠加的效果。
那些生活技艺也能逐步增加罗德的底蕴。
【投掷】涵盖了所有的投掷武器。
包括投矛、飞斧、短标枪之类的都算数。
而【远射】所包含的类型就更多了，各类弓弩甚至是攻城蝎弩都作数。
抛石索则是同时能受到【投掷】和【远射】的双重加持。
往后的三项就不用多赘述了。
杂艺分类也有六项。
它们是：【赌博】、【阅读】、【心眼】、【威慑】、【魅力】、【骑乘】。
杂艺所提供的技能比较天马行空。
其中【心眼】似乎跟潜在的感知力有关。
他到目前为止还未摸索出有效的训练方式。
content_en:
;;
After Rhodes finished the breathing method, he sat cross-legged on the mat.
Start practicing meditation.
With the assistance of the [Immersion] effect, he can quickly enter a meditative state.
Feel the magical elements flowing through your body, and your mind gradually becomes empty.
The chaotic thoughts and all kinds of negative emotions were swept away like garbage.
When he opened his eyes again, his whole mind felt extremely refreshed.
The quality of magic elements in the body has been slightly improved.
[Demon Tempering Experience +2]
He did not take advantage of his recovery to continue practicing Demon Tempering.
Your daily energy is always limited, and haste makes waste.
Rhodes next practiced throwing knives and short bow shooting with Philip.
I gained some experience in [Throwing] and [Long Shot].
His skills are broadly divided into Living, Combat, and Acrobatics.
Ten life skills have been activated.
They are:
[Construction], [Planting], [Gathering], [Cultivation], [Hunting], [Cooking], [Manufacturing], [Craftsmanship], [Medicine], [Control].
Covering almost all the skills necessary for farming and production in a broad sense.
After mastering them all, he becomes the Lord Almighty King.
If you want to gain as much experience as possible.
He had to find time and energy to work.
We must truly come from the masses and go to the masses.
Rhodes always kept in mind the nine-character motto of building walls high, hoarding grain widely, and becoming king slowly.
If farming is a daily routine of steady development.
Then fighting is the romance of the lord
He has six activated combat skills:
[Quenching Demon], [Throwing], [Long Shot], [Soldier Strike], [Parry], [Running].
Among them, [Throwing] can also add to each other with [Dice Rolling] by running in both directions.
Facts have proven that these skills of his can achieve complementary or buff stacking effects.
Those life skills can also gradually increase Rhodes' heritage.
[Throwing] covers all throwing weapons.
Including throwing spears, throwing axes, short javelins, etc. all count.
And [Long Shot] includes even more types, including various types of crossbows and even siege scorpion crossbows.
The sling can be dually blessed by [Throwing] and [Long Shot] at the same time.
There is no need to elaborate on the next three items.
There are also six categories in the variety arts category.
They are: [Gamble], [Reading], [Mind Eye], [Deterrence], [Charm], and [Ride].
The skills provided by acrobatics are quite imaginative.
Among them, [Mind's Eye] seems to be related to potential perception.
He has yet to find an effective training method.
